name: Marketing Specialist

sections.daily_work: Create and execute marketing campaigns. Write content for social media, blogs, and ads. Analyze campaign performance. Manage brand voice. Collaborate with design and sales teams.
sections.learning: Digital marketing, content creation, SEO/SEM, social media strategy, email marketing, analytics tools (Google Analytics), basic design (Canva, Adobe), copywriting.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $40,000-$55,000 USD. Mid-level $55,000-$80,000. Senior marketers can earn $90,000-$130,000. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Marketing or communications degree, Google Ads and Analytics certification, HubSpot certifications, content portfolio (blog, social media), marketing internships.

try_in_real_life: Start a blog or social media account around a topic you love
Take the free Google Digital Marketing course (Google Digital Garage)
Analyze ads you see: who's the target audience, what's the hook?
Get a free HubSpot Inbound Marketing certification
sources: American Marketing Association salary surveys; BLS advertising and marketing data
